==Usage instructions==
<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>
==Notes and references==
{{ScrollBox|content=
{{Reflist}}
}}
</nowiki></pre>

If {{Tl|Mediacat}} is to be placed in the Notes and references section in accordance with the [[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide|Layout Guide]], then do this to ensure correct formatting:

<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>
==Notes and references==
{{ScrollBox|content=
{{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of EXAMPLE}}
{{Reflist}}
}}
</nowiki></pre>

NOTE: Optional '''height''' and '''width''' variables can be used to control the width of the scroll box (height defaults to 400 pixels; the former "scroll box" template was 230 pixels)&mdash;nowadays, this is usually unnecessary:
<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>
{{ScrollBox|height=300px|content=
}}
</nowiki></pre>

<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>
{{ScrollBox|width=100%|content=
}}
</nowiki></pre>

<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>
{{ScrollBox|height=230px|width=100%|content=
}}
</nowiki></pre>
